facts.fact: Djibouti Telecom says twelve submarine cables pass through Djibouti and on land connect to four separate self-powered stations watched round the clock.
Djibouti Telecom says its cable infrastructure serves more than 50 telecom operators with connections to more than 90 countries, who can switch between cables there.

note: Sea-Me-We-6 is an investment, not stated in service; no design capacity above 100 Tbps stated.
